data.cultural_impact: Randhir is a classic Hindu name, popular in India and among the Indian Diaspora. The name carries a rich cultural heritage and a sense of pride in one's Indian origin. It is also an auspicious name and is considered lucky in many communities. The name is also associated with the Hindu god Vishnu, who is revered as the preserver of the universe, and the protector of the world. This association with Vishnu adds a spiritual dimension to the name, making it a favorite among those who seek spiritual enrichment.
data.spiritual_significance: Randhir is a deeply spiritual name, rooted in Hinduism and the philosophy of Vedas. The name represents a connection to the divine and a strong faith in the protection and jurisdiction of the Hindu deity Vishnu. It gives a sense of security and peace, as one believes that the Almighty Vishnu is always with them, guiding and protecting them. The name also signifies a strong moral character, as Lord Vishnu is considered to be the embodiment of morality and righteousness. Randhir is not just a name, it's a symbol of faith, devotion, and spiritual enrichment.

historical_references.reference: Randhir was a famous poet and scholar in medieval India, best known for his work 'Randhira Rasa' which is a commentary on the works of Kalidasa. He lived during the 12th to 13th century.
Randhir is also mentioned in the epic Mahabharata as the name of a king in the Haihayas dynasty, during the Mahabharata war. His exact time period is not mentioned in the text.
